decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the roof extensions hereby permitted shall match those used in roof of the existing building.
description: Erection of a rear and side roof extension with one front roof window and the installation of a window to the existing garage.
